paper.title: Close-coupled calculation of collisions of magnetostatically trapped metastable helium atoms

research.objective: Quantum-mechanical close-coupled calculation for collisions of spin-polarized triplet helium atoms in a magnetostatic trap, with Penning and associative ionization represented by a complex optical potential. Calculate rate coefficients for spin relaxation and relaxation-induced Penning ionization for a range of magnetic fields and temperatures spanning cold and ultracold regimes. Investigate sensitivity to molecular potentials and autoionization width.
research.system: Spin-polarized metastable triplet helium He*(2^3S) atoms in a magnetostatic trap
key_features: External magnetic field included via Zeeman interaction
Symmetrization for identical atoms (gerade states, even partial waves)

molecular_states.label: ^5Σ_g^+
molecular_states.description: Quintet state, spin-polarized entrance channel, autoionization spin-forbidden

molecular_states.label: ^1Σ_g^+
molecular_states.description: Singlet state, accessible via spin relaxation, high Penning ionization probability
molecular_states.potential_source: Müller et al. (Ref. 30), modified long-range to match ^5Σ_g^+

space_fixed.M_j: Projection of j onto space-fixed z-axis
space_fixed.M_l: Projection of l onto space-fixed z-axis
space_fixed.M_J: Projection of J onto space-fixed z-axis

body_fixed.Λ: Projection of L onto internuclear axis (Λ=0 for Σ states)
body_fixed.Σ: Projection of S onto internuclear axis
body_fixed.Ω: Projection of j onto internuclear axis (Ω = Λ + Σ)

quantum_numbers.symmetry: Only gerade states and even l contribute due to identical zero-spin nuclei

basis_sets: Hund's case (e) basis: |R, J M_J j l⟩ (Eq. 9)
Transformed basis: |R, M_J j l a⟩ diagonalizing asymptotic Zeeman Hamiltonian (Eq. 23)

theory.hamiltonian: H = T + H_rot + H_el + H_so + H_Zee + H_sd (Eq. 2)

components.H_el: Electronic Hamiltonian: H_1 + H_2 + H_12, diagonal in adiabatic molecular potentials ^2S+1 V_Λ(R) (Eq. 14)
components.H_so: Spin-orbit: a(R) L·S, zero for Σ states
components.H_Zee: Zeeman: g_s μ_B B·S = g_s μ_B B S_z (Eq. 20)

theory.close_coupled_equations: N coupled second-order differential equations for radial functions F_{j'l'a',jla}^{M_J}(E,R) (Eq. 26)
theory.complex_optical_potential: For ^1Σ_g^+ state: ^1V_S(R) → ^1V_S(R) - iΓ(R)/2, where Γ(R) is total autoionization width for He_2*(^1Σ_g^+) entrance channel

scattering_formalism.reactance_matrix: K complex due to complex potential

theory.symmetrization: Symmetrized channel states used (Ref. 45), only gerade states and even l contribute

numerical.basis_truncation: Include l' = l, l±2; maximum 18 coupled equations. Error estimated by including l±4.

parameters_varied.temperatures: Cold and ultracold regimes (1 mK – 300 K implied)

numerical.convergence: Truncation error numerically determined by repeating select calculations with extended basis

observables.energy_range: Cold and ultracold (explicit range not given in excerpt)

sensitivity.elastic_and_inelastic: Particularly sensitive to short-range ^5Σ_g^+ molecular potential
sensitivity.relaxation_induced_PI: Sensitive to short-range ^1Σ_g^+ molecular potential and autoionization width Γ(R)

results.comparison: Validated against perturbative treatment of spin-dipole interaction (Ref. 12)
results.key_finding: Spin polarization reduces Penning ionization rate by five orders of magnitude compared to unpolarized case (threshold rate ~5×10^{-10} cm^3/s for unpolarized, Ref. 3)

key_equations.description: Total angular momentum basis (Hund's case e)
Transformed molecular basis diagonalizing Zeeman interaction
Asymptotic solution, reactance matrix, scattering matrix

theoretical: Close-coupled approach valid for magnetostatic trap; for magneto-optical trap, spontaneous emission and population recycling must be considered (weak-field limit, large detuning required)
Quantum complex potential method assumes weak field and large detuning to neglect spontaneous emission
Basis truncation (l' = l, l±2) introduces error, estimated by including l±4
Autoionization width Γ(R) uncertain; sensitivity investigated but not fully constrained
limitations.computational: Maximum 18 coupled equations solved; extension to magneto-optical case would require larger basis and treatment of recycling
